text_block_list.text:
Having conquered the Hopeful Stakes,
Голд Шип
finds herself adrift without a
goal. Is there
nowhere left for her
competitive spirit to go?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She decides to pursue the art of putting

decorative leaves into sushi boxes. Is
that really
what you want, Голд Шип?!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Then, the Book of Secrets appears
before Gold
Ship, enlightening her of
the path to Eden. The
knowledge
motivates her to gear up for the
Classics
in earnest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
